## Summary

Describe the change and the user need it addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] Release build passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] New behavior has tests.
- [ ] No generated output, credentials, certificates, or private keys are included.

## Safety and compatibility

Confirm this change does not add DRM bypass, malicious code, arbitrary command
execution, remote script execution, or automatic execution of downloaded files.
